=={{header|Omegese}}==
{{works with|omc|sha256 2c824805, aien-dev/omega-mv e5b32567, Linux AArch64}}
Omega has no imports, so the small output helpers (<code>emit</code> and friends) are part of the program.
<syntaxhighlight lang="text">
om2
text nl "\n"
text sp " "
text poem "---------- Ice and Fire ------------\n\nfire, in end will world the say Some\nice. in say Some\ndesire of tasted I've what From\nfire. favor who those with hold I\n\n... elided paragraph last ...\n\nFrost Robert -----------------------\n"
note emit writes every byte of a to stdout; a short write is retried, an error exits 1
fn emit a view uchar * to void
o = ulong 0
while lt o len a bound 4096
k = write 1 a o sub len a o
if le k 0
exit 1
end
o = add o ulong k
end
end
note revline prints the space-separated words of a in reverse order, one space between them
fn revline a view uchar * to void
st = new ulong 64 0
ln = new ulong 64 0
k = ulong 0
i = ulong 0
while lt i len a bound 4096
if eq get a i 32
i = add i 1
else
j = i
while lt j len a bound 4096
if eq get a j 32
break
end
j = add j 1
end
put st k i
put ln k sub j i
k = add k 1
i = j
end
end
for w ulong k
if gt w 0
emit sp
end
x = sub sub k 1 w
emit part a get st x get ln x
end
emit nl
end
fn main to int
s = ulong 0
for i ulong len poem
if eq get poem i 10
revline part poem s sub i s
s = add i 1
end
end
ret 0
end
</syntaxhighlight>
{{out}}
<pre>
------------ Fire and Ice ----------

Some say in ice.
From what I've tasted of desire
I hold with those who favor fire.

... last paragraph elided ...

</pre>
